## 1. TensorRT on the T4

cuda:0 (Tesla T4, sm_75), TensorRT 11.3.0.99, batch 1. Accuracy on Cityscapes full val (500 images) at 512×1024, in mIoU points; *held out* is `val_minus_sens100`, the 400 images not used to choose the mixed configurations (D-017). Latency is the probe at the 990 MHz clock lock (D-027): 20 warmup + 3 × 400 frames. The budget gates the engine's `infer` span (D-026); e2e adds the Python pre- and post-processing at full label resolution (D-028), which isn't part of the engine.

## 4. Latency vs accuracy, and the final engines

Each point is one TensorRT engine: mIoU change on `sens_val100` against trtexec GPU compute p50 at 990 MHz. The finalists then got the full probe and full val, and the rule fixed before any INT8 result (D-033) chose the final engine: the lowest `infer` p99 among engines passing every gate, with differences under the tie band counted as ties, and ties going to fewer quantized nodes.

### SegFormer-B0

![SegFormer-B0: latency vs accuracy](figures/pareto__segformer_b0.png)

| Candidate | `infer` p99 (ms) | full val vs FP32 | held out vs FP32 | quantized nodes | perf + parity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| INT8+FP16, s0.patch_embed in FP16 | 9.349 | −0.103 | +0.005 | 70 | pass |
| INT8+FP16, s2.attn_matmul in FP16 | 9.705 | −0.153 | −0.099 | 67 | pass |
| INT8+FP16, s2.mlp in FP16 | 9.711 | −0.066 | +0.011 | 67 | pass |
| **FP16** | 9.548 | +0.006 | +0.007 | 0 | pass |

Final: **FP16** (tied with the fastest, fewer quantized nodes; tie band 3.5%, up to 9.677 ms).

## 5. Where the time goes: FP16 vs INT8

Sum of per-layer medians by layer type (trtexec `--dumpProfile`, 990 MHz), in ms. SegFormer runs layers on several streams in parallel, so its sums exceed the wall-clock compute time. INT8 only speeds up the matrix layers; the rest sets the ceiling (Amdahl's law).

### SegFormer-B0

|  | FP16 | best INT8 |
|---|---|---|
| Matrix layers (conv, GEMM) | 3.077 | 2.504 |
| `kgen` (TensorRT-generated kernels) | 3.253 | 3.267 |
| Reformat | 0.984 | 0.874 |
| Resize, pooling | 0.254 | 0.254 |
| Sum of layers | 7.569 | 6.898 |
| trtexec compute p50 | 5.988 | 5.679 |

Speed-up of compute p50: 1.05×.

Sources: [trtexec__segformer_b0__fp16__c5profile__990MHz__ab77361.json](../artifacts/reports/trtexec__segformer_b0__fp16__c5profile__990MHz__ab77361.json) · [trtexec__segformer_b0__sens_s0.patch_embed__c5profile__990MHz__ab77361.json](../artifacts/reports/trtexec__segformer_b0__sens_s0.patch_embed__c5profile__990MHz__ab77361.json)
